scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @minda/backend" "npm run dev -w @minda/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @minda/backend && npm run build -w @minda/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run start -w @minda/backend" "npm run start -w @minda/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @minda/common && npm run typecheck -w @minda/backend && npm run typecheck -w @minda/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @minda/common && npm run test -w @minda/backend
